messages:
maya: Started canary for model v3.2-quant-lite at 10% traffic, rolling over 2h. quick note: we saw perf win but some metric drift. asking for threshold opinions. :thinking:
claire: saw ~38% token-cost reduction and 24% lower p99 latency in synthetic trace, nice. but longdoc MRR down ~1.2% in early slices.
rohit: infra observation: KV cache miss rate spiked during warmup bursts, settled after ~30m. no OOMs.
sam: ops: tail latency stable for interactive slices, background batch saw slight queueing during burst. alerting muted for smoke run.
maya: raw numbers: concordance drop 1.2% rel, hallucination rate +0.6% abs on our longdoc slices. propose auto-fallback rule ideas: either rel delta >1.5% OR hall rate increase >0.8% -> immediate rollback.
claire: prefer softer hysteresis: require 3 consecutive 5m windows crossing threshold before rollback, to avoid noise. also cap immediate rollback to critical user-impact slices only.
maya: agreed on hysteresis. also want an absolute floor for tiny-sample slices (ignore if n<100).
rohit: config note: during warmstart we should disable immediate fallback for first 45m to allow KV warmup. otherwise we get false positives.
claire: ok add warmup hold: 45m. and add decay factor so longer-running canaries tighten thresholds after 60m.
maya: draft policy attached:```json
{"auto_fallback":true,"relative_mrr_threshold":0.0125,"abs_hall_threshold":0.008,"hysteresis_windows":3,"window_size_mins":5,"warmup_mins":45,"tighten_after_mins":60}```
claire: LGTM with one tweak: set relative_mrr_threshold to 0.01 (1.0%) for critical slices. others keep 1.25%.
sam: ops +1 on hysteresis and warmup, we want one alert channel for immediate ops visibility even if rollback delayed.
rohit: adding note: make sure rollback uses pinned compatible float model (non-quant) and route traffic gracefully. prefer gradual 50%->0 over 2min to avoid queue bursts.
deploy-bot: canary rolled to 10% at 4881234567. health checks passing. monitor links: https://console/redwood/canary/4881234567
maya: cool. action items: Claire to finalize slice-wise thresholds, Rohit to add warmup/gradual rollback logic, Sam to configure alert channel. will reconvene after 2h smoke. :rocket:
